spellbook.finance/limitations: This creates inventory items and exact price locks in the workspace. It does not change, end, relist or publish anything on the marketplace.

Each price lock holds a printing at the live price, so repricing leaves it alone until the lock is cleared with spellbook_sku_exact_price_lock_clear. A listing adopted without a lock is named in limitations with its reason.

A created eBay item has status listed, bin EBAY-IMPORT, acquisition price 0 and acquisition source ebay_adoption. A created tcg or manapool item is owned, in bin TCG-IMPORT or MANAPOOL-IMPORT, with acquisition source tcg_adoption or manapool_adoption, and the channel sync lists it. Set real costs later.

The first answer is the preview with applyStatus applying. applyResult is null until applyStatus is applied, then it counts listingsAdopted, itemsLinked, itemsCreated, priceLocksSet and listingsSkipped.
It is safe to repeat. A repeat call after a partial run continues the same plan and does not create a second item for the same remote copy.
adoption_preview_not_found with status 404 means no preview with this id exists on this channel. Pass the channel the preview was started on.

adoption_preview_not_ready with status 409 means the preview is still reading or failed. adoption_preview_expired means it is older than 24 hours. Start a new preview and show the person the new counts. adoption_apply_running means another preview of this workspace is applying, and runningPreviewId names it. Read that preview with spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview until it is applied, then start a new preview. When it shows applying with no progress for 15 minutes, call this tool on runningPreviewId, which dispatches its stalled apply again.

free_seller_workspace_required or free_seller_workspace_claim_required with status 409 means the caller does not own or has not claimed this workspace. Nothing was adopted. The 10,000-copy allowance is soft and never produces this error.
owner_required with status 403 means the signed-in person is not the workspace owner.
listingsSkipped counts listings another writer started managing after the preview. limitations names the other skips.
A new copy of an adopted printing, finish and condition can raise the quantity of the adopted listing. That is the existing behavior for any listing SpellBook manages.

description: Adopt the listings in a ready preview from spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview. Each remote copy is linked to an owned item or gets a new item in the channel's import bin (EBAY-IMPORT, TCG-IMPORT or MANAPOOL-IMPORT), and the listing is recorded as managed by SpellBook. Each adopted printing gets an exact price lock at its live price. Nothing on the marketplace is edited, ended or relisted, and nothing is published. Applying runs in the background. The first answer has applyStatus applying. Call spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview with previewId latest until applyStatus is applied. Show the person the preview before the first call.

channel.description: The marketplace of the preview: ebay, tcg for TCGplayer, or manapool. Defaults to ebay.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

maxUnits.description: Adopt whole listings, highest live price first, until this many copies. Omit to adopt every adoptable listing. Pass it only when the person asks to adopt fewer copies. The allowance never requires it.

previewId.description: The previewId of a ready, unexpired preview from spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_preview. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that owns the preview. Required. Only the workspace owner can apply.

name: spellbook_marketplace_listings_adopt_apply
